notes: «جدتي أم عاصم» is one link: the relation word is dropped and the name stands alone (rule 7).
«وكانت أم ولد، لسنان بن سلمة» describes her status: not a link.
Nabisha is named inside the story but is the one who relays the Prophet's saying («فحدثنا أن رسول الله ...»): last link (rule 6).
The compiler's remark «وقد روى يزيد بن هارون وغير واحد ... عن المعلى بن راشد» names other transmitters of this hadith: a variant group; the text does not fix its place in the chain.
